description: This file is a C/C++ header file defining interfaces for sensing features in a wireless local device test helper module. It includes function declarations for getting vendor data, sending sensing commands, adding and removing clients, retrieving CSI stats, and resetting stats, along with necessary includes and include guards.

methods.name: sensingGetVendorData
methods.description: Returns vendor-specific data associated with a radio.

methods.name: wld_th_rad_sensing_cmd
methods.description: Sends a sensing command to the radio.

methods.name: wld_th_rad_sensing_addClient
methods.description: Adds a client to the sensing module for the specified radio.

methods.name: wld_th_rad_sensing_delClient
methods.description: Removes a client from the sensing module based on MAC address.

methods.name: wld_th_rad_sensing_csiStats
methods.description: Retrieves CSI statistics from the radio.

methods.name: wld_th_rad_sensing_resetStats
methods.description: Resets statistics in the sensing module.
